title: Lora's Key
summary: Opens the first-floor chest in Lora’s House.

fields.Acquisition: Carried by Lora Bergauz. The chest contains an auction receipt and random gem. A DC 15 Sleight of Hand check is an alternative.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
